border.$description: The edge of a level-1 layer, the same as every level's: envUI draws no shadows, so the edge and the fill set a floating layer apart.

The edge of menus, Select and Combobox lists, popovers, hover cards, pickers, rich text suggestions, docked panels and drag images: about 2:1 against a popup's own fill and the page, and at least 1.6:1 against every surface it floats over.
The edge of dialogs, sheets and the command palette, the same as level 2's; a modal's scrim sets it apart as well.

elevation.$description: Elevation 0–3: the edge color of each level, for layers that float over the page. envUI draws no shadows: a floating layer separates by its fill and this edge, and a modal by its scrim as well. Level 0 is flat; menus, Select lists and popovers take level 2, dialogs and sheets level 3. Levels 1–3 share one edge, clearly visible at about 2:1 against a popup and the page; in high contrast it is the 4.5:1 boundary, and under forced colors the system's.
